material_to_state: grain lot + identified host lot -> dispersion batch -> aliquot + accepted cell -> loaded state -> settled child state
state_to_run: settled state + frozen condition + approved instrument/calibration/clock references -> run -> spent child state
run_to_analysis: run -> immutable pressure/image raw-reference hashes -> versioned derived-reference record
job_to_closeout: each registered preparation/qualification/measurement job -> safe release + contained disposition + inspection/reuse record
all_to_archive: all route dispositions + all job closeouts + rejected history + twenty qualification holds -> immutable archive
physical_chronology: Evidence ingestion order is not a physical schedule; actual same-cell reuse/custody chronology remains externally qualified
